premises.text: Gen Y users do not know where their money goes and need fun, fast budgeting/tracking
premises.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes. None. I spend and I just don't think about it

premises.text: Expense input must be extremely fast—under three seconds on phone
premises.evidence_span: whip out your phone and input any expense in under three seconds

premises.text: App never asks for bank/credit-card credentials or even name—anonymity
premises.evidence_span: We'll never ask you for your credit card or bank information, not even your name

premises.text: Proactive logging engages users with their finances at the moment of spend
premises.evidence_span: When it comes to your finances, we believe that being proactive is the key

premises.text: Game mechanics—XP, tokens, achievements, leveling—encourage tracking habits
premises.evidence_span: we're going to make it fun and rewarding. Gen Y, or my generation, is all about playing games

premises.text: Pattern/frequency tagging surfaces likely merchants and categories automatically
premises.evidence_span: Spends tracks both the pattern and frequency of my top tags and intuitively responds

premises.text: Tokens unlock sponsored deals matched to spending habits as a monetization path
Subcategory budgets and age-peer You Versus Them insights deepen tracking value
Mobile is primary with web backup dashboard; product always free for users
premises.evidence_span: we also built Spends Web to instantly back up everything you do on your mobile account

domains.name: Gen Y budgeting problem and proactive stance

value.text: Fun, fast budgeting and money tracking so users know where cash goes
value.evidence_span: solve the problem of budgeting and tracking your money. Not like everybody else, but fun and fast

causal_links.evidence_span: I have no idea where my money goes
input any expense in under three seconds
working with companies to get the right deals in front of the right audience

notes: XP/tokens/achievements/leveling folded as one game-mechanics premise (§4.1.7). Demo McDonald's/girlfriend flows are cascade of fast input+tags. Bootstrap/launch timing excluded as traction. Free-forever is commercial facet of P9. Singleton D3: sponsored deals are separately revisable monetization module. Anti-template: need, product, deals separately revisable.
